problem_description: Compute the average_potential_energy_per_particle in eV for a three-dimensional MD simulation in LAMMPS using real units and full atom style with periodic boundary conditions in all directions. Bonded interactions must be described using a Morse potential, while angular, dihedral, and improper terms are neglected. Nonbonded interactions should be treated using a hybrid overlay scheme combining a three-body harmonic NB3B potential with pairwise Lennard–Jones and Coulomb interactions, applied with a cutoff of 10.0 Å and arithmetic mixing rules. Intramolecular nonbonded interactions must exclude 1–2 and 1–3 pairs and fully include 1–4 interactions. Long-range electrostatic and dispersion forces should be computed using an Ewald-based k-space solver with a relative accuracy of 10⁻⁴. delayed neighbor lists must be constructed using a bin algorithm with a 2.0 Å skin and updated every five time steps. Time integration should be performed using a two-level RESPA scheme with a base time step of 1.0 fs, evaluating short-range forces at the inner level and k-space forces at the outer level. The system should first be energy-minimized to energy and force tolerances of 10^-6 and 10^-8, respectively, followed by velocity initialization at 298 K using a Maxwell–Boltzmann distribution with zero net momentum. Finally, equilibrate the system in the NVE ensemble for 10,000 time steps while maintaining the temperature at 298 K via periodic velocity rescaling.
